headline: Paraguay: Rashtrapati Pena hataye gaye, nazarband
detail: Paraguay ki Senate ne Ueno Bank ghotala ke baad Rashtrapati Santiago Pena ko mahaabhiyog se hataya; ve ghar me nazarband hain, aur Up-Rashtrapati Pedro Alliana ne shapath li.
exam_angle: Paraguay me rashtrapati par mahaabhiyog — Latin America ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.
image_credit: Office of the President, Taiwan / CC BY 4.0

headline: Miller bane Trump ke chief of staff
detail: Trump ne Stephen Miller ko White House chief of staff banaya; Susie Wiles ne midterm haar ke baad istifa diya, Miller 9 November se pad sambhalenge.
exam_angle: America ke White House me bada badlav — midterm chunaav ke baad ki rajneeti.

headline: Congo me hamle me 33 ki maut
detail: Purvi Congo ke Cantine gaon me ADF ladakon ke hamle me kam se kam 33 log mare gaye; Ebola ke marijo ko swasthya kendra se bhaagna pada.
exam_angle: Congo me Ebola aur sashastr hinsa — Africa ki swasthya aur suraksha chunauti.

headline: America me October me 1.65 lakh naukriyan
detail: America me October me 1,65,000 naukriyan judi aur berozgari 4.1% rahi; BLS ke anusar bharti September se zyada rahi.
exam_angle: America ki rozgar report — vaishvik arthvyavastha aur Fed ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Iran ke Qeshm dweep par do missile gire
detail: Iran ki Tasnim agency ke anusar Qeshm dweep ke Suza kshetra me do missile gire; nuksan ki abhi koi aadhikarik jaankari nahi hai.
exam_angle: Faras ki khadi ke paas sthit Qeshm dweep — America-Iran tanav ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Kyiv par raat bhar ballistic missile hamle
detail: Russia ne 6-7 November ki raat Kyiv par ballistic missileon ki kai lehrein chalai; Solomianskyi jile me ek aawasiya imarat kshatigrast hui aur aag lagi.
exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — Kyiv ki urja aur nagrik buniyadi dhanche par hamle.

headline: Zaporizhia sahayata kendra hamle me 53 ki maut
detail: Zaporizhia ke Komyshuvakha gaon me sahayata kendra par Russian hamle me marne walon ki sankhya 53 ho gayi; malbe me dabe logon ki khoj jaari hai.
exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh me nagrikon par sabse ghatak hamlo me se ek.

headline: Qatar ke Emir ne Trump se Iran par baat ki
detail: Qatar ke Emir Sheikh Tamim ne Trump se phone par Iran se tanav kam karne aur madhyasthata par baat ki; Iran ne Qatar ke zariye parmanu prastav bhi bheja hai.
exam_angle: Qatar ki madhyasthata — America-Iran tanav me kootneeti.

headline: Rubio ki pehli videsh yatra: Paris me G7 baithak
detail: America ke Videsh Mantri Marco Rubio 8-10 November ko Paris me G7 videsh mantriyon se milenge; midterm haar ke baad ye unki pehli videsh yatra hai.
exam_angle: G7 videsh mantri baithak — Ukraine aur Iran par charcha.

headline: America me khasa 35 saal me sabse zyada
detail: CDC ke anusar 2026 me America me khasa ke 5,182 mamle mile — 1991 ke baad sabse zyada; kam se kam 8 logon ki maut hui.
exam_angle: America me khasa ka punarutthan aur teekakaran — swasthya aur UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Europe me nakli bomb dhamkiyon se udane thap
detail: Guruvar ko Europe bhar me kam se kam 27 udanein nakli bomb dhamkiyon se prabhavit hui; ladaku vimanon ne kai vimanon ko suraksha jaanch ke liye utara, koi visfotak nahi mila.
exam_angle: Europe me hybrid yuddh aur vimanan suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Trump: factory na banane par 300% tariff
detail: Trump ne kaha America me factory na banane wali videshi companiyon par 300% tak tariff lag sakta hai; midterm haar ke baad bhi ve tariff niti par kayam hain.
exam_angle: America ki vyapar niti aur tariff — Bharat ke niryaat aur vaishvik vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Belgium: Raja ne PM ka istifa thukraya
detail: Belgium ke Raja Philippe ne PM Bart De Wever ka istifa thukra diya; budget par baatchit phir shuru hogi, De Wever 16 November ko Raja ko report denge.
exam_angle: Belgium me sarkar sankat aur budget — Europe ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Tokyo ke paas samundar me 6.1 bhukamp
detail: Japan ke Kanto tat ke paas samundar me 6.1 teevrata ka bhukamp aaya; tsunami ki chetavni nahi di gayi aur koi nuksan ya ghayal ki khabar nahi hai.
exam_angle: Japan me bhukamp aur tsunami chetavni vyavastha — bhugol ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Yemen: Taiz bazaar hamle me 30 ki maut
detail: Yemen ke Taiz me Al-Hadara bazaar par hamle me kam se kam 30 log mare gaye aur 8 ghayal hue; Houthi aur sarkari bal ek dusre par aarop laga rahe hain, zimmedari abhi tay nahi hui.
exam_angle: Yemen me griha yuddh aur manaviya sankat — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: America: Iran par khabar par $2 crore inaam
detail: America ne Iran ke parmanu karyakram par jaankari ke liye 20 million dollar tak ka inaam aur sambhav sthanantaran ki ghoshna ki; CENTCOM ne Rewards for Justice karyakram ke tahat jaankari mangi.
exam_angle: Iran parmanu karyakram aur America ki niti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: FDA: Zolgensma gene therapy se tumour ka khatra
detail: America ki FDA ne Novartis ki Zolgensma gene therapy se tumour ke khatre ki jaanch shuru ki; do bachchon me vector ke DNA judne ke saboot mile, kul nau mamle darj hue.
exam_angle: Gene therapy ki suraksha aur FDA ki nigrani — swasthya aur vigyan ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Amsterdam me Microsoft data centre par pradarshan
detail: Amsterdam me saikadon pradarshankari Microsoft ke data centre ke nirman sthal me ghus gaye, crane par chadhe aur flare jalaye; police ne 150-200 logon ko giraftar kiya.
exam_angle: Europe me data centre virodh aur AI ki urja maang — paryavaran aur takneek ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Guterres: COP31 jalvayu par satya ka pal
detail: UN mahasachiv Antonio Guterres ne COP31 se pehle kaha ki jalvayu parivartan par ab 'satya ka pal' hai; 9-20 November ko Antalya me shikhar sammelan hoga, unke karyakal ka aakhri bada sandesh.
exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu sammelan aur Paris samjhauta ka 1.5°C lakshya — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya sangathan ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Pope Leo ka 12-din ka Latin America daura
detail: Pope Leo XIV ne fefde ke cancer ki surgery ke teen hafte baad Dakshin America ka 12-din ka daura shuru kiya; ve Uruguay, Argentina aur Peru jayenge, 17 November ko Peru me samapt hoga.
exam_angle: Pope Leo XIV ka pehla bada Latin America daura — Vatican aur vishva dharm ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: White House ke paas hathiyarbhand vyakti giraftar
detail: America ki Secret Service ne White House ke paas ek chori ki gaadi me teen hathiyaron ke saath Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos ko giraftar kiya; usne kaha awaazein use Trump ko maarne ko keh rahi thi, DHS ke anusar ve hirasat me hai.
exam_angle: America me rashtrapati ki suraksha aur Secret Service ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: America ki Madhya Purv me suraksha chetavni
detail: America ne Madhya Purv ke 10 deshon me reh rahe nagrikon ko Houthi hamlo aur udan radd hone ke khatre par satark rehne ki chetavni di; Videsh Vibhag ne hawai kshetra band hone aur yatra me badha ki aashanka jatai.
exam_angle: Madhya Purv me America-Iran tanav aur suraksha chetavni — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: France me school bus haadsa, 2 ki maut
detail: Lyon se Bourg-en-Bresse ja rahi intercity bus Lent ke paas sadak se utar kar ped se takrai; ek nabalig aur 18 saal ke yuvak ki maut hui, 16 ghayal hue jinme 3 gambhir hain.

headline: Zelenskyy: Yuddh khatm kiye bina samjhauta khatarnak
detail: CNN ko diye interview me Zelenskyy ne kaha, yuddh khatm kiye bina Russia-Europe ke beech naya suraksha samjhauta khatarnak hoga, khaas taur par EU ke liye; Ukraine, America aur Russia ke beech ek hafte me trilateral baatchit hogi.
exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur Europe ki suraksha vyavastha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Khadi me tanker par hamla, navik ki maut
detail: Marshall Islands ke tanker MT Velos Sapphire par Khadi me sandehspad missile hamle ke baad visfot hua; operator Velos Tankers ne ek navik ki maut ki pushti ki, jahaz Bahrain le jaya gaya.
exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur samudri suraksha — antarrashtriya vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Iran ne parmanu sthalon ke paas iodine baanta
detail: America ke hamle ke dar ke beech Iran ne apne parmanu sthalon ke paas rehne wale logon ko iodine ki goliyan baantni shuru kar di hain; The Times of London ki report ke anusar Pickaxe Mountain sthal par hamle ki aashanka hai.
exam_angle: Iran parmanu karyakram aur America se tanav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Ukraine ne Saratov refinery par drone hamla kiya
detail: Raat bhar ke hamle me Saratov refinery me aag lag gayi aur Oryol ki Proton factory par Neptune missile gira; Russia ne 411 drone rokne ka daava kiya.
exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh me oorja dhanche par hamle — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Qatar: America-Iran samjhauta vaarta jaari, khabar jhoothi
detail: Qatar ke media office ne kaha ki PM ke bayan ko online bigada gaya; dono paksh samjhote ki taraf kaam kar rahe hain aur madhyasthata jaari hai.
exam_angle: Paschim Asia me Qatar ki madhyasthata — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Qatar: America-Iran ke beech do-din ka bridge deal
detail: Qatar ke madhyasthon ne America aur Iran ko do din me vishwas-badhane wale kadmon ka prastav diya hai — America nakabandi hataye aur jama dhan chhode, Iran IAEA nirikshakon ko bomb wale parmanu sthalon par jaane de aur dusre din Hormuz khole; Qatar ke PM ne kaha madhyasthata jaari hai aur samjhaute par khaasi pragati hui hai.
exam_angle: America-Iran parmanu vaarta me Qatar ki madhyasthata aur Hormuz jalmarg — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Beijing: Xi-Trump-Putin baithak par baatchit jaari
detail: Cheen ne pehli baar pusht ki hai ki woh Shenzhen me APEC shikhar ke kinare Xi, Trump aur Putin ki aitihasik tripakshiya baithak par baatchit kar raha hai; abhi kuchh tay nahi hai.
exam_angle: APEC shikhar aur teen badi shaktiyon ki tripakshiya kootniti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Iran ka daava: Qeshm par US drone giraya
detail: Iran ki sena ne kaha uski vayu raksha ne Qeshm dweep ke upar America ka MQ-9 drone gira diya, aur sena pravakta ne chetavni di ki naya hamla hua to jawab ki koi seema nahi hogi.
exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur America-Iran tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Trump: Iran se takraav 'yuddh nahi'
detail: Trump ne kaha paanch mahine me koi ghayal ya mara nahi, isliye Iran ke saath jaari takraav yuddh nahi hai, aur kaha America ne Iran se tel nikasi me pragati ki hai.
exam_angle: America-Iran takraav par rashtrapati ka bayan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Hormuz: Ek hafte me 11 jahazon par hamle
detail: UKMTO ki haftavaar report ke anusar 6 November ko khatm hafte me Hormuz ke aas-paas 11 jahazon par hamle hue, jinme se teen doob gaye; aavaagaman sangharsh se pehle ke star se lagbhag 65% kam raha.
exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur samudri suraksha — antarrashtriya vyapar aur suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Mexico: Police helicopter se goli, bacchi ki maut
detail: Tamaulipas ke abhiyojak ne pusht ki hai ki 29 October ko Matamoros me cartel ke khilaf karravai ke dauraan police helicopter se ki gayi golibari me America me janmi saat saal ki Aranza ki maut ho gayi; goli chalane wale adhikari abhi aazaad hain.
exam_angle: America-Mexico seema par police ki golibari aur nagrik suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Hormuz: IMO ke anusar 25 navikon ki maut
detail: Sanyukt Rashtra ki samudri sanstha IMO ne kaha 28 February se Hormuz sangharsh me kam se kam 25 navikon ki maut hui aur 130 se zyada vyaapaarik jahazon par hamle hue; taaza shikar 5 November ko Velos Sapphire par mara navik tha.
exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg, IMO aur samudri suraksha — antarrashtriya vyapar aur suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Houston: Police ab ICE ko kam sahyog degi
detail: Houston ke Mayor John Whitmire ne karyakari aadesh se police ko nirdesh diya ki ab ICE ko sirf tab suchit kiya jaye jab giraftaar vyakti par jail yogya aarop ho aur ICE warrant bhi ho; mamuli traffic rok par sirf challan milega, koi suchna nahi.
exam_angle: America me sthaniya police aur sanghiya immigration pravartan — sanghwad aur rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Tesla Cybertruck band, jagah legi Cybercab
detail: Elon Musk ne kaha Tesla agle saal ke madhya se Texas factory me Cybertruck ka utpadan kam karegi taaki usi jagah Cybercab robotaxi ka utpadan badhaya ja sake; Cybertruck ke mukhya engineer ne bhi iske ant ka sanket diya.
exam_angle: Tesla ka robotaxi ki taraf badlav — EV aur swachaalit vaahan udyog ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Saudi: Mecca ke paas drone giraya gaya
detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne shukravar ko Mecca kshetra me ek drone aur Najran ki taraf aaye do ballistic missile giraye; shanivaar ko Riyadh ki taraf aaya ek cruise missile bhi roka gaya, koi nuksan nahi hua.
exam_angle: Madhya Purv me Saudi-Houthi sangharsh — Bharat ke tel margon aur suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.
outlets: Institute for the Study of War

headline: Sao Paulo: Imaarat giri, chaar ghayal
detail: Sao Paulo ke Bras vyaapaarik ilaake me shukravar shaam ek chaar-manzila vyaapaarik imaarat ki chhat gir gayi; andar maujood 35 logon ko surakshit nikala gaya, chaar ghayal aspatal me sthir hain.

headline: Florida: CAIR ne kaam roka, 'aatanki' tag par
detail: America ke sabse bade Muslim adhikar sangathan CAIR ne Florida me kaam rok diya, kyunki sanghiya nyayadhish ne rajya ke 'gharelu aatanki sangathan' wale kanoon par rok lagane se mana kar diya; sangathan faisle ke khilaf appeal karega.
exam_angle: America me nagrik adhikar aur rajya shakti ka sangharsh — samvidhanik adhikaron ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Kyiv: Raat bhar missile-drones, bridge toota
detail: Russia ne raat ko Kyiv aur aas-paas par 36 ballistic missile aur 172 drone daage; Northern Bridge aur bijli-paani ki suvidhaon ko nuksan pahuncha, ek ki maut aur nau ghayal hue.
exam_angle: Abu Dhabi me mangalvar se Russia-Ukraine-America ki trilateral vaarta se pehle hamla — yuddh aur vaarta, dono ek saath.

headline: Iran ne missile range ki seema hatayi
detail: Iran ke Revolutionary Guard ne apni ballistic missile par 2,000 kilometer ki khud ki seema hata li; pravakta ne kaha kshamata ko 'vyavhar me dikhaya jayega', maujooda missile ki pushti nahi ki.
exam_angle: Madhya Purv me tanaav aur Bharat ki urja suraksha — Hormuz marg par asar.

headline: America: Khasra 35 saal me sabse zyada
detail: America me 2026 me ab tak khasure ke 5,182 mamle darj hue — 1991 ke baad sabse zyada; zyadatar sankramit bina teeka ke the, Pennsylvania sabse zyada prabhavit.
exam_angle: Teeka-karan coverage me girawat aur uske parinam — swasthya neeti aur jan-swasthya ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Trump: Stephen Miller naye chief of staff
detail: Trump ne Stephen Miller ko White House chief of staff banaya, Susie Wiles ki jagah; Miller 9 November se pad sambhalenge, Wiles ab Trump ki political operation me jayengi.
exam_angle: Midterm haar ke baad White House me bada ferbadal — Trump prashasan ki aage ki disha ka sanket.

headline: Europe: Jhoothi bomb dhamkiyon se udanein thap
detail: Shukravar ko Europe me phir jhoothi bomb dhamkiyon ki lehar — kai udanein divert hui, ladaku vimanon ne escort kiya; sabhi viman surakshit utre, koi visfotak nahi mila; Ireland me RTE ka mukhyalaya khali karaya gaya.
